result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Client retains its content, IP and data; owns deliverables and work product through a present assignment; TrueLink retains pre-existing or independently developed IP while granting Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded IP; and joint ownership is excluded. The amendment is confined to allocating ownership and necessary licence rights without materially disturbing unrelated terms. Minor drafting issues prevent a top score: the reference to “Section 8(d)” is potentially ambiguous given the duplicate subsection labels, and the margin comment inaccurately describes the embedded-IP licence as a licence “back to TrueLink” when it is granted to Client.
